plates.prompt: Create a professional four-panel 2 by 2 contact sheet for a Chinese grade-one geometry lesson set at a tiny museum of shapes. A single landscape 3:2 canvas; all four equal rectangles in perfect quadrants with clean division exactly at 50 percent; no gutters, frames, text, numbers, signs, glyphs or labels. Every quadrant is an independently crop-ready, wide environment illustration. Style all panels consistently in art-directed fine paper texture, matte opaque gouache, delicately cut paper edges, warm ivory and deep pine, apricot and persimmon accents; quiet child-level readability, no gradients, no glossy 3D. Top left: Chinese boy with cropped dark hair and olive overalls and Chinese girl with dark bob and apricot sweater excitedly unpacking museum supplies at a timber exhibition workshop, near side and no text; clear main object group toward the lower center right, airy warm wall at top. Top right: warm timber sorting workshop, front facing straight-on and symmetrical, big EMPTY pale wheat floor in middle, pine cabinet and fabric only at edges; no characters, no tables in middle. Bottom left: warmly lit indoor museum arcade with tiled floor, pine windows, apricot trim and an EMPTY bright central floor for a game overlay, tiny plants at far side only; no characters. Bottom right: same Chinese girl at home showing a small wooden block face to a seated parent near a paper sheet, warm pine curtains, calm right-leaning composition, no text. Geometry taught on separate exact diagrams, keep background decoration secondary.

One 3:2 landscape cutout atlas with real transparent background and exactly six independent isolated asset silhouettes. Neat 3 columns by 2 rows of equal cells, one object centered in each cell, each fitting within inner 58% of its cell, extra transparent empty gutters, do not cross cell boundaries. Paper cutout gouache, matte pine, cream, apricot and persimmon, same tiny school shape museum world; strong silhouettes for 50 pixel display; no outlines drawn as dividing grid, no floor or cast shadow, no lettering, numerals or symbols. Row 1 left: toy yellow push cart seen from above slightly front, body box and two wheels, nose points to right. Row 1 center: same yellow push cart nose to right tipped very slightly in action and a little off-white dust directly behind its wheels, no artifacts. Row 1 right: handsome small pine museum sticker badge with a soft apricot border and no lettering or star text. Row 2 left: top-down toy apricot bubble rover points RIGHT, has distinct right-facing nose, cream windows and pine wheels. Row 2 center: exact same top-down apricot rover points RIGHT with three little bubbles close to right-facing nose, no trails across cells. Row 2 right: softly painted award rosette with cream paper and dark pine ribbon, no text. Each position independently crop-ready.
